description.value: Fast Fired by Carbone is a BC-based quick-service pizza chain offering fully customizable pizzas with over a million topping combinations, fired fresh to order. The menu spans classic and signature pies, pastas, paninis, salads, calzones, and wings, with a strong selection of vegan and gluten-free options. A rewards program and VIP pizza passes make it a practical stop for cyclists looking for a filling, affordable meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Fast Fired is an active pizza chain (Fast Fired by Carbone) with online ordering, a rewards program, and a menu including vegan and gluten-free options. The rewards page explicitly states 'Dine-in & pickup only – No delivery,' confirming takeout. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM community field says 'Richmond' but coordinates (49.1482, -122.8896) and the street address '7988 80 Avenue' place this location in Surrey, BC, not Richmond — the website's VIP pass pages also reference a 'Surrey' location, corroborating this discrepancy.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Richmond' but coordinates (49.1482, -122.8896) and the address '7988 80 Avenue' are consistent with Surrey, BC, not Richmond. The website's VIP pass pages reference a 'Surrey' location, further suggesting the community label is incorrect.
Website does not list a location-specific phone number or street address, so the OSM phone number and address cannot be independently verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating pizza chain with confirmed takeout service and an active website; useful to touring cyclists as a food stop with vegan and GF options.

Takeout.detail: Rewards page states 'Dine-in & pickup only – No delivery,' confirming pickup/takeout is available

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ confirms gluten-free dough (vegan), Daiya vegan cheese, and all dough types are vegan. Menu includes a dedicated Vegan Pizzas section
